"import cadquery as cq

LX = 100.0
LY = 60.0
T = 8.0
FILLET_R = 8.0
HOLE_D = 6.0
HOLE_R = HOLE_D / 2.0
HX = 35.0
HY = 15.0

part = cq.Workplane("XY").rect(LX, LY).extrude(T)
part = part.edges("|Z").fillet(FILLET_R)
part = (part.faces(">Z").workplane()
        .pushPoints([(HX, HY), (HX, -HY), (-HX, HY), (-HX, -HY)])
        .circle(HOLE_R).cutThruAll())

cq.exporters.export(part.val(), "part.step")"
